target_sources(Test_Main
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/RecordingTest.cpp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SceneUpdaterTest.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(Test_Main PRIVATE Camelot_replay)

# RecordingTest replays the recording generated by Tests/fixtures/make_fixture.py.
target_compile_definitions(Test_Main
                           PRIVATE CAMELOT_TEST_FIXTURES_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/fixtures")
